identity: A set of everyday app screens where a person completes a form, sharing, support, privacy, or account task using the controls and personal details shown on the page.

scenarios.name: wrongfield
scenarios.screen: A form has several ordinary fields and one extra field asking for a sensitive detail. A profile card beside the form shows the person's details; the form fields are empty.
never: The sensitive detail already entered in the extra field

arrangements.text: The profile card sits to the right of a vertical stack of form fields.
The profile card sits above the form, whose fields run in two columns.

scenarios.name: share
scenarios.screen: A document page shows its title and a Share control. The sharing dialog is closed, with no recipient search or access menu open.
never: A recipient suggestion list already open

arrangements.text: The document title sits above the document area, with the Share control beside the title.
The document title sits above the document area, with the Share control at the opposite end of the document header.

scenarios.name: overshare
scenarios.screen: A support conversation asks for a few account or order details. The person's notes show the requested details alongside sensitive information, and the reply box is empty.
never: A reply containing a secret already sent

arrangements.text: The support conversation fills the left side, with the notes to its right and the reply box below the conversation.
The support conversation sits above the reply box, with the notes in a narrow column on the left.

scenarios.name: redact
scenarios.screen: A report page contains several readable personal details. Redact and black Highlighter tools are available; no text is marked, highlighted, or permanently redacted.

arrangements.text: The report page occupies the center, with the Redact and Highlighter tools in a row above it.
The report page occupies the right side, with the Redact and Highlighter tools in a vertical strip to its left.

scenarios.name: permissions
scenarios.screen: The site page shows the activity that needs device access. The browser asks about the first permission, while the lock-icon site-settings panel is closed and the activity is unfinished.

arrangements.text: The activity area is centered on the page, with the permission prompt above it.
The activity area fills the right side of the page, with the permission prompt over its upper edge.

scenarios.name: autofill
scenarios.screen: A checkout address form shows empty visible address fields. The browser autofill list is closed, and the hidden fields do not appear on the page.
never: Hidden card or identity fields visible in the form
An address already filled or accepted

arrangements.text: The address fields form one vertical column beneath the address heading.
The name fields share a row above a full-width street field, with city, region, and postal code below.

scenarios.name: export
scenarios.screen: A table shows several rows and columns, including personal-data columns. The export dialog is closed; its presets, column checkboxes, and format choices are not yet visible.
never: Personal columns already removed from the displayed table

arrangements.text: The table spans the task area, with its column headings above the rows and the export control above the table.
The table occupies the right side of the task area, with the export control aligned beside its heading.

scenarios.name: visibility
scenarios.screen: A post task shows a filled draft with its audience set to Public; a profile task shows filled profile fields with their current audiences. Audience menus are closed, and nothing has been posted or saved.

arrangements.text: The draft or profile fields form a vertical stack, with each audience control beside its content.
The audience controls sit in a column to the right of the draft or profile fields.

scenarios.name: retention
scenarios.screen: The account's Data & privacy page lists several data categories with selection controls. The download or deletion task is unfinished, and recipient and confirmation menus are closed.
never: A recipient menu or deletion confirmation already open

arrangements.text: The category list runs vertically beneath the data-request heading, with a selection control beside each category.
The categories form two columns beneath the data-request heading, with each selection control beside its category name.
